title: The pullback of the structure sheaf is the structure sheaf
statement: Let $g:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $g^\sharp:\mathcal O_Y\to g_*\mathcal O_X$, and let $g^*\dashv g_*$ be the pullback and pushforward of modules [def-pc-module-pullback] with unit $\eta_g$; regard $\mathcal O_Y$ and $\mathcal O_X$ as modules over themselves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], so that $g^\sharp$ is a morphism of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules. Let $\epsilon_g:g^*\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$ be the morphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules corresponding to $g^\sharp$ under the adjunction, i.e. the unique one with $g_*(\epsilon_g)\circ\eta_{g,\mathcal O_Y}=g^\sharp$ (on an open $W\subseteq Y$ and $a\in\mathcal O_Y(W)$: $\epsilon_g(\eta_g(a))=g^\sharp(a)\in\mathcal O_X(g^{-1}W)$). Then $\epsilon_g$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Sheaves, Definition 0095 (definition-pushforward): $g^*\mathcal O_Y=\mathcal O_X\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal O_Y}g^{-1}\mathcal O_Y=\mathcal O_X$, with the adjunction of Lemma 0096 (lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules); used without statement in Modules, Lemma 01BG (lemma-pullback-quasi-coherent), proof

proof.text: Choose the tensor pullback adjunction. By the definition of epsilon and apply_symm_apply, its image under the Hom equivalence is the structure-sheaf map.

For every X-module M, precomposition with epsilon corresponds under the adjunction and unitHomEquiv to pushforwardSections. This follows from homEquiv_naturality_right and pushforwardSections_unitHomEquiv. The latter map is bijective by SheafOfModules.bijective_pushforwardSections: Opens.map g.base is final, as proved in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Topology.Category.TopCat.Opens (the comma category has the top open as terminal object). Hence precomposition is bijective for every M, and isIso_iff_coyoneda_map_bijective gives that epsilon is an isomorphism.
Adjunction.homEquiv_unit rewrites the Hom-equivalence identity from step 1 as the asserted composite of the adjunction unit with pushforward of epsilon.
